name: create_workspace
description: Create a workspace for a new agent.

provider_id.description: The provider ID; omit it to create in the default provider.

project_id.description: The project ID; omit it to create in that provider's default project.

target_id.description: The target ID of the host, exactly as the projects list gives it, and only for a project whose line carries a target_id; a project listed without one takes none.

name.description: The workspace's name: the developer's own when they chose one, otherwise a short, specific name composed from what the workspace is for, in a few words with no punctuation. Always supply one, except in a project listed as naming its own workspaces, which takes none.
